ValidationRule.description: Hard stop: invoice with GP under 22% must have COO override permission
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), (AND( NOT(ISBLANK(GP_Percent__c)), GP_Percent__c < 22, NOT($Permission.GP_Floor_Override) )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice blocked: GP under 22% requires COO release
